mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course (id, coach_id, student_id, start_time, end_time, price, status, table_number, create_time, update_time, deleted) VALUES (#{id}, #{coachId}, #{studentId}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{price}, #{status}, #{tableNumber}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{deleted})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM course WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM course WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY start_time DESC
SELECT * FROM course WHERE coach_id = #{coachId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY start_time DESC

SELECT c.id, DATE(c.start_time) as date, c.start_time, c.end_time, 'course' as type, '乒乓球课程' as title, camp.name as location, c.table_number, CASE WHEN c.student_id = #{userId} THEN c.coach_id ELSE c.student_id END as with_user_id, CASE WHEN c.student_id = #{userId} THEN coach.name ELSE student.name END as with_user_name, CASE WHEN c.student_id = #{userId} THEN 'coach' ELSE 'student' END as with_user_role, c.status FROM course c LEFT JOIN user student ON c.student_id = student.id LEFT JOIN user coach ON c.coach_id = coach.id LEFT JOIN campus camp ON student.campus_id = camp.campus_id WHERE (c.student_id = #{userId} OR c.coach_id = #{userId}) AND c.deleted = 0 AND c.start_time >= #{startDate} AND c.start_time <= #{endDate} AND c.status IN ('confirmed', 'completed') ORDER BY c.start_time ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE course SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
